acupressure.name: Acupressure

acupressure.shortDesc: Raises a random stat of the user or an ally by 2.

aerialace.name: Aerial Ace
aerialace.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

afteryou.name: After You
afteryou.desc: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.
afteryou.shortDesc: The target makes its move right after the user.

alluringvoice.name: Alluring Voice
alluringvoice.desc: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
alluringvoice.shortDesc: 100% confuse target that had a stat rise this turn.

allyswitch.name: Ally Switch
allyswitch.desc: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.
allyswitch.shortDesc: User and ally swap positions; using again can fail.

ancientpower.name: Ancient Power

ancientpower.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).

appleacid.name: Apple Acid
appleacid.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
appleacid.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

aquacutter.name: Aqua Cutter
aquacutter.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

aquaring.name: Aqua Ring
aquaring.desc: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.
aquaring.shortDesc: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn.

aquastep.name: Aqua Step
aquastep.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
aquastep.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.

armorcannon.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
armorcannon.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

aromaticmist.name: Aromatic Mist
aromaticmist.desc: Raises the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
aromaticmist.shortDesc: Raises an ally's Sp. Def by 1.

assurance.name: Assurance
assurance.desc: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.
assurance.shortDesc: Power doubles if target was damaged this turn.

attract.name: Attract
attract.desc: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
attract.shortDesc: A target of the opposite gender gets infatuated.

aurasphere.name: Aura Sphere
aurasphere.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

aurawheel.name: Aura Wheel
aurawheel.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.

auroraveil.name: Aurora Veil
auroraveil.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.
auroraveil.shortDesc: For 5 turns, damage to allies halved. Snow only.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.desc: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.
avalanche.shortDesc: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.

axekick.name: Axe Kick
axekick.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.
axekick.shortDesc: 30% confusion. User loses 50% max HP if miss.

babydolleyes.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
babydolleyes.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

banefulbunker.name: Baneful Bunker
banefulbunker.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

barbbarrage.name: Barb Barrage
barbbarrage.desc: Has a 50% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target is already poisoned.
barbbarrage.shortDesc: 50% psn. 2x power if target already poisoned.

batonpass.name: Baton Pass
batonpass.desc: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.
batonpass.shortDesc: User switches, passing stat changes and more.

beakblast.name: Beak Blast
beakblast.desc: If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.
beakblast.shortDesc: Burns on contact with the user before it moves.

beatup.name: Beat Up
beatup.desc: Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.
beatup.shortDesc: All healthy allies aid in damaging the target.

belch.name: Belch
belch.desc: Fails unless the user has eaten a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.
belch.shortDesc: Fails unless the user has eaten a Berry.

bellydrum.name: Belly Drum
bellydrum.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.
bellydrum.shortDesc: User loses 50% max HP. Maximizes Attack.

bind.name: Bind
bind.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
bind.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

bite.name: Bite
bite.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
bite.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

bitterblade.name: Bitter Blade
bitterblade.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
bitterblade.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

bittermalice.name: Bitter Malice
bittermalice.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
bittermalice.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

blastburn.name: Blast Burn
blastburn.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

blazekick.name: Blaze Kick
blazekick.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.
blazekick.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to burn.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.
blizzard.shortDesc: 10% chance to freeze foe(s). Can't miss in Snow.

block.name: Block
block.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
block.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

bodypress.name: Body Press
bodypress.desc: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.
bodypress.shortDesc: Uses user's Def stat as Atk in damage calculation.

bodyslam.name: Body Slam
bodyslam.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

bonerush.name: Bone Rush
bonerush.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

boomburst.name: Boomburst
boomburst.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

bravebird.name: Brave Bird
bravebird.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

breakingswipe.name: Breaking Swipe
breakingswipe.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
breakingswipe.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.

brickbreak.name: Brick Break
brickbreak.desc: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
brickbreak.shortDesc: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.

brutalswing.name: Brutal Swing
brutalswing.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

bugbite.name: Bug Bite
bugbite.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
bugbite.shortDesc: User steals and eats the target's Berry.

bugbuzz.name: Bug Buzz
bugbuzz.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
bugbuzz.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

bulkup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
bulkup.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

bulldoze.shortDesc: 100% chance lower adjacent Pkmn Speed by 1.

bulletseed.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

burningjealousy.name: Burning Jealousy
burningjealousy.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
burningjealousy.shortDesc: 100% burns a target that had a stat rise this turn.

burnup.name: Burn Up
burnup.desc: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.
burnup.shortDesc: User's Fire type becomes typeless; must be Fire.

calmmind.name: Calm Mind
calmmind.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
calmmind.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1.

ceaselessedge.name: Ceaseless Edge
ceaselessedge.desc: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. A maximum of three layers may be set, and opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
ceaselessedge.shortDesc: Sets a layer of Spikes on the opposing side.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.
charge.shortDesc: +1 SpD, user's next Electric move 2x power.

chargebeam.name: Charge Beam
chargebeam.desc: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
chargebeam.shortDesc: 70% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

charm.name: Charm
charm.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

chillingwater.name: Chilling Water
chillingwater.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
chillingwater.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

chillyreception.name: Chilly Reception
chillyreception.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

circlethrow.name: Circle Throw
circlethrow.desc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
circlethrow.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

clangingscales.name: Clanging Scales
clangingscales.desc: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage.

clangoroussoul.name: Clangorous Soul
clangoroussoul.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.
clangoroussoul.shortDesc: User loses 33% of its max HP. +1 to all stats.

clearsmog.name: Clear Smog
clearsmog.shortDesc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

closecombat.name: Close Combat
closecombat.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
closecombat.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

coaching.name: Coaching
coaching.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
coaching.shortDesc: Raises an ally's Attack and Defense by 1.

coil.name: Coil
coil.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.
coil.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack, Defense, accuracy by 1.

comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
comeuppance.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.
comeuppance.shortDesc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5x damage.

confuseray.name: Confuse Ray
confuseray.desc: Causes the target to become confused.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.desc: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.
copycat.shortDesc: Uses the last move used in the battle.

corrosivegas.name: Corrosive Gas
corrosivegas.desc: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

cosmicpower.name: Cosmic Power
cosmicpower.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
cosmicpower.shortDesc: Raises the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

cottonguard.name: Cotton Guard
cottonguard.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.

cottonspore.name: Cotton Spore
cottonspore.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

counter.name: Counter
counter.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.
counter.shortDesc: If hit by physical attack, returns double damage.

covet.name: Covet
covet.desc: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
covet.shortDesc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
crabhammer.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

crosschop.name: Cross Chop
crosschop.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

crosspoison.name: Cross Poison
crosspoison.desc: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.
crosspoison.shortDesc: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to poison.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.desc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
crunch.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

crushclaw.name: Crush Claw
crushclaw.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
crushclaw.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.
curse.shortDesc: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.

darkestlariat.name: Darkest Lariat
darkestlariat.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.
darkestlariat.shortDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.

darkpulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
darkpulse.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

dazzlinggleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
dazzlinggleam.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

decorate.name: Decorate
decorate.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.
decorate.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 2.

defog.name: Defog
defog.desc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.
defog.shortDesc: -1 evasion; ends user and target hazards/terrain.

destinybond.name: Destiny Bond
destinybond.desc: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.
destinybond.shortDesc: If an opponent knocks out the user, it also faints.

detect.name: Detect
detect.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
detect.shortDesc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

dig.name: Dig
dig.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

direclaw.name: Dire Claw
direclaw.desc: Has a 30% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.
direclaw.shortDesc: 30% chance to sleep, poison, or paralyze target.

disable.name: Disable
disable.desc: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.
disable.shortDesc: For 4 turns, disables the target's last move used.

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

dive.name: Dive
dive.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

doubleedge.name: Double-Edge
doubleedge.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

doublehit.name: Double Hit
doublehit.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

doubleteam.name: Double Team

dracometeor.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

dragoncheer.name: Dragon Cheer
dragoncheer.desc: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.
dragoncheer.shortDesc: Ally: Crit ratio +1, or +2 if ally is Dragon type.

dragondance.name: Dragon Dance
dragondance.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.
dragondance.shortDesc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1.

dragondarts.name: Dragon Darts
dragondarts.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.
dragondarts.shortDesc: Hits twice. Doubles: Tries to hit each foe once.

dragonrush.name: Dragon Rush
dragonrush.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
dragonrush.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

dragontail.name: Dragon Tail
dragontail.desc: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
dragontail.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

drainingkiss.name: Draining Kiss
drainingkiss.desc: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
drainingkiss.shortDesc: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.

drainpunch.name: Drain Punch
drainpunch.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
drainpunch.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

drillrun.name: Drill Run
drillrun.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

dualwingbeat.name: Dual Wingbeat
dualwingbeat.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

dynamicpunch.name: Dynamic Punch
dynamicpunch.desc: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.

earthpower.name: Earth Power
earthpower.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
earthpower.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.desc: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.
earthquake.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dig.

eerieimpulse.name: Eerie Impulse
eerieimpulse.desc: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.
eerieimpulse.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 2.

eeriespell.name: Eerie Spell
eeriespell.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the target loses 3 PP from its last move.
eeriespell.shortDesc: Removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

electricterrain.name: Electric Terrain
electricterrain.desc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.

electrify.name: Electrify
electrify.desc: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
electrify.shortDesc: Changes the target's move to Electric this turn.

electroball.name: Electro Ball
electroball.desc: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.
electroball.shortDesc: More power the faster the user is than the target.

electroshot.name: Electro Shot
electroshot.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, the move still requires a turn to charge.
electroshot.shortDesc: Raises Sp. Atk by 1, hits turn 2. Rain: no charge.

electroweb.name: Electroweb
electroweb.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
electroweb.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

encore.name: Encore
encore.desc: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.
encore.shortDesc: Target repeats its last move for its next 3 turns.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.
endeavor.shortDesc: Lowers the target's HP to the user's HP.

endure.name: Endure
endure.desc: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
endure.shortDesc: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.

energyball.name: Energy Ball
energyball.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
energyball.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
entrainment.shortDesc: The target's Ability changes to match the user's.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.desc: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
eruption.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

expandingforce.name: Expanding Force
expandingforce.desc: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.
expandingforce.shortDesc: User on Psychic Terrain: 1.5x power, hits foes.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.desc: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
explosion.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.

extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
extrasensory.desc: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
extrasensory.shortDesc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.

facade.name: Facade
facade.desc: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.
facade.shortDesc: Power doubles if user is burn/poison/paralyzed.

fairylock.name: Fairy Lock
fairylock.desc: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.
fairylock.shortDesc: Prevents all Pokemon from switching next turn.

fakeout.name: Fake Out
fakeout.desc: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
fakeout.shortDesc: Hits first. First turn out only. 100% flinch chance.

faketears.name: Fake Tears
faketears.desc: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
faketears.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.

featherdance.name: Feather Dance
featherdance.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

feint.name: Feint
feint.desc: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.
feint.shortDesc: Nullifies Detect, Protect, and Quick/Wide Guard.

fellstinger.name: Fell Stinger
fellstinger.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 3 stages if this move knocks out the target.
fellstinger.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack by 3 if this KOes the target.

ficklebeam.name: Fickle Beam
ficklebeam.shortDesc: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.

fierydance.name: Fiery Dance
fierydance.desc: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
fierydance.shortDesc: 50% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

finalgambit.name: Final Gambit
finalgambit.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.
finalgambit.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's HP. User faints.

fireblast.name: Fire Blast
fireblast.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

firefang.name: Fire Fang
firefang.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
firefang.shortDesc: 10% chance to burn. 10% chance to flinch.

firelash.name: Fire Lash
firelash.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
firelash.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

firepunch.name: Fire Punch
firepunch.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

firespin.name: Fire Spin
firespin.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
firespin.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

firstimpression.name: First Impression
firstimpression.desc: This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
firstimpression.shortDesc: Nearly always goes first. First turn out only.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
fissure.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

flail.name: Flail
flail.desc: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
flail.shortDesc: More power the less HP the user has left.

flamecharge.name: Flame Charge
flamecharge.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
flamecharge.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

flareblitz.name: Flare Blitz
flareblitz.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
flareblitz.shortDesc: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to burn. Thaws user.

flashcannon.name: Flash Cannon
flashcannon.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
flashcannon.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

flatter.name: Flatter
flatter.desc: Raises the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and confuses it.
flatter.shortDesc: Raises the target's Sp. Atk by 1 and confuses it.

fling.name: Fling
fling.desc: The power of this move is based on the user's held item. The held item is lost and it activates for the target if applicable. If there is no target or the target avoids this move by protecting itself, the user's held item is still lost. The user can regain a thrown item with Recycle or the Harvest Ability. Fails if the user has no held item, if the held item cannot be thrown, if the user is under the effect of Embargo or Magic Room, or if the user has the Klutz Ability.
fling.shortDesc: Flings the user's item at the target. Power varies.

flipturn.name: Flip Turn
flipturn.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
flipturn.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.

flowertrick.name: Flower Trick
flowertrick.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities. This move does not check accuracy.
flowertrick.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit; no accuracy check.

fly.name: Fly
fly.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
fly.shortDesc: Flies up on first turn, then strikes the next turn.

flyingpress.name: Flying Press
flyingpress.desc: This move combines Flying in its type effectiveness against the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
flyingpress.shortDesc: Combines Flying in its type effectiveness.

focusblast.name: Focus Blast
focusblast.desc: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
focusblast.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

focusenergy.name: Focus Energy
focusenergy.desc: Raises the user's chance for a critical hit by 2 stages. Fails if the user already has the effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.
focusenergy.shortDesc: Raises the user's critical hit ratio by 2.

focuspunch.name: Focus Punch
focuspunch.desc: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.
focuspunch.shortDesc: Fails if the user takes damage before it hits.

followme.name: Follow Me
followme.desc: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
followme.shortDesc: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.

forestscurse.name: Forest's Curse
forestscurse.desc: Causes the Grass type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Grass type. If Trick-or-Treat adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
forestscurse.shortDesc: Adds Grass to the target's type(s).

foulplay.name: Foul Play
foulplay.desc: Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.
foulplay.shortDesc: Uses target's Attack stat in damage calculation.

freezedry.name: Freeze-Dry
freezedry.desc: This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.

frenzyplant.name: Frenzy Plant
frenzyplant.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

frostbreath.name: Frost Breath
frostbreath.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
frostbreath.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.

futuresight.name: Future Sight
futuresight.desc: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.
futuresight.shortDesc: Hits two turns after being used.

gastroacid.name: Gastro Acid
gastroacid.desc: Causes the target's Ability to be rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this move fails, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

gigadrain.name: Giga Drain
gigadrain.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
gigadrain.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

gigaimpact.name: Giga Impact
gigaimpact.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

gigatonhammer.name: Gigaton Hammer
gigatonhammer.shortDesc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

grassknot.name: Grass Knot
grassknot.desc: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.
grassknot.shortDesc: More power the heavier the target.

grassyglide.name: Grassy Glide
grassyglide.desc: If the current terrain is Grassy Terrain and the user is grounded, this move has its priority increased by 1.

grassyterrain.name: Grassy Terrain
grassyterrain.desc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain. During the effect, the power of Grass-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, the power of Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5, and grounded Pokemon have 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn, including the last turn. Camouflage transforms the user into a Grass type, Nature Power becomes Energy Ball, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause sleep. Fails if the current terrain is Grassy Terrain.

gravapple.name: Grav Apple
gravapple.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. Power is multiplied by 1.5 during Gravity's effect.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.desc: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.

growth.name: Growth
growth.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sunny Day or Desolate Land, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sunny Day or Desolate Land.
growth.shortDesc: Raises user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; 2 in Sun.

guardsplit.name: Guard Split
guardsplit.desc: The user and the target have their Defense and Special Defense stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
guardsplit.shortDesc: Averages Defense and Sp. Def stats with target.

guardswap.name: Guard Swap
guardswap.desc: The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.
guardswap.shortDesc: Swaps Defense and Sp. Def changes with target.

guillotine.name: Guillotine
guillotine.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
guillotine.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

gunkshot.name: Gunk Shot
gunkshot.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

gyroball.name: Gyro Ball
gyroball.desc: Power is equal to (25 * target's current Speed / user's current Speed) + 1, rounded down, but not more than 150. If the user's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 1.
gyroball.shortDesc: More power the slower the user than the target.

hammerarm.name: Hammer Arm
hammerarm.desc: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

hardpress.name: Hard Press
hardpress.desc: Power is equal to 100 * (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
hardpress.shortDesc: More power the more HP the target has left.

haze.name: Haze
haze.desc: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.

headlongrush.name: Headlong Rush
headlongrush.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
headlongrush.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.

headsmash.name: Head Smash
headsmash.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

healbell.name: Heal Bell
healbell.desc: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.
healbell.shortDesc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.

healingwish.name: Healing Wish
healingwish.desc: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP is fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets either of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.
healingwish.shortDesc: User faints. Next hurt Pokemon is fully healed.

healpulse.name: Heal Pulse
healpulse.desc: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.
healpulse.shortDesc: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.

heatcrash.name: Heat Crash
heatcrash.desc: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
heatcrash.shortDesc: More power the heavier the user than the target.

heatwave.name: Heat Wave
heatwave.desc: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

heavyslam.name: Heavy Slam
heavyslam.desc: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
heavyslam.shortDesc: More power the heavier the user than the target.

helpinghand.name: Helping Hand
helpinghand.desc: The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.
helpinghand.shortDesc: One adjacent ally's move power is 1.5x this turn.

hex.name: Hex
hex.desc: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
hex.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target has a status ailment.

highjumpkick.name: High Jump Kick
highjumpkick.desc: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.
highjumpkick.shortDesc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.

horndrill.name: Horn Drill
horndrill.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
horndrill.shortDesc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.

hornleech.name: Horn Leech
hornleech.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
hornleech.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

howl.name: Howl
howl.desc: Raises the Attack of the user and all allies 1 stage.
howl.shortDesc: Raises the user's and ally's Attack by 1.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.desc: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
hurricane.shortDesc: 30% chance to confuse target. Can't miss in rain.

hydrocannon.name: Hydro Cannon
hydrocannon.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

hyperbeam.name: Hyper Beam
hyperbeam.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

hypervoice.name: Hyper Voice
hypervoice.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
hypnosis.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

icebeam.name: Ice Beam
icebeam.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

icefang.name: Ice Fang
icefang.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
icefang.shortDesc: 10% chance to freeze. 10% chance to flinch.

icehammer.name: Ice Hammer
icehammer.desc: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

icepunch.name: Ice Punch
icepunch.desc: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

icespinner.name: Ice Spinner
icespinner.desc: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

iciclecrash.name: Icicle Crash
iciclecrash.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
iciclecrash.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

icywind.name: Icy Wind
icywind.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
icywind.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

imprison.name: Imprison
imprison.desc: The user prevents all opposing Pokemon from using any moves that the user also knows as long as the user remains active.
imprison.shortDesc: No foe can use any move known by the user.

infernalparade.name: Infernal Parade
infernalparade.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.
infernalparade.shortDesc: 30% burn. 2x power if target is already statused.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.desc: Has a 100% chance to burn the target.

infestation.name: Infestation
infestation.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
infestation.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

ingrain.name: Ingrain
ingrain.desc: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect. During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.

instruct.name: Instruct
instruct.desc: The target immediately uses its last used move. kingsshield.name: King's Shield
kingsshield.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Attack lowered by 1 stage. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. kingsshield.shortDesc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -1 Atk.

knockoff.name: Knock Off
knockoff.desc: This move's power is multiplied by 1.5 if the target is holding an item, and the target loses its held item if the user has not fainted. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. This move does not increase in power or remove the target's item if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
knockoff.shortDesc: 1.5x damage if foe holds an item. Removes item.

kowtowcleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
kowtowcleave.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

lashout.name: Lash Out
lashout.desc: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
lashout.shortDesc: 2x power if the user had a stat lowered this turn.

lastresort.name: Last Resort
lastresort.desc: This move fails unless the user knows this move and at least one other move, and has used all the other moves it knows at least once each since it became active or Transformed.
lastresort.shortDesc: Fails unless each known move has been used.

lastrespects.name: Last Respects
lastrespects.desc: Power is equal to 50+(X*50), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side, and X cannot be greater than 100.
lastrespects.shortDesc: +50 power for each time a party member fainted.

leechlife.name: Leech Life
leechlife.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
leechlife.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

leechseed.name: Leech Seed
leechseed.desc: The Pokemon at the user's position steals 1/8 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. If Big Root is held by the recipient, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue being leeched. If the target switches out or uses Mortal Spin or Rapid Spin successfully, the effect ends. Grass-type Pokemon are immune to this move on use, but not its effect.
leechseed.shortDesc: 1/8 of target's HP is restored to user every turn.

lifedew.name: Life Dew
lifedew.desc: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
lifedew.shortDesc: Heals the user and its allies by 1/4 their max HP.

lightofruin.name: Light of Ruin
lightofruin.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

lightscreen.name: Light Screen
lightscreen.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
lightscreen.shortDesc: For 5 turns, special damage to allies is halved.

liquidation.name: Liquidation

liquidation.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

lockon.name: Lock-On
lockon.desc: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.
lockon.shortDesc: User's next move will not miss the target.

lowkick.name: Low Kick
lowkick.desc: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.
lowkick.shortDesc: More power the heavier the target.

magicpowder.shortDesc: Changes the target's type to Psychic.

magicroom.name: Magic Room
magicroom.desc: For 5 turns, the held items of all active Pokemon have no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. magicroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all held items have no effect.

magneticflux.name: Magnetic Flux

Fails if the user is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

matchagotcha.shortDesc: 20% burn. Recovers 50% dmg dealt. Thaws foe(s).

meanlook.name: Mean Look
meanlook.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
meanlook.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

memento.name: Memento
memento.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. The user faints unless this move misses or there is no target. Fails entirely if this move hits a substitute, but does not fail if the target's stats cannot be changed.
memento.shortDesc: Lowers target's Attack, Sp. Atk by 2. User faints.

metalburst.name: Metal Burst
metalburst.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.
metalburst.shortDesc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5x damage.

meteorbeam.shortDesc: Raises user's Sp. Atk by 1 on turn 1. Hits turn 2.

mirrorcoat.name: Mirror Coat
mirrorcoat.desc: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a special attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's special attack this turn.
mirrorcoat.shortDesc: If hit by special attack, returns double damage.

mistyexplosion.name: Misty Explosion
mistyexplosion.desc: If the current terrain is Misty Terrain and the user is grounded, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5. The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
mistyexplosion.shortDesc: User faints. User on Misty Terrain: 1.5x power.

mistyterrain.name: Misty Terrain
mistyterrain.desc: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Misty Terrain. During the effect, the power of Dragon-type attacks used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5 and grounded Pokemon cannot be inflicted with a non-volatile status condition nor confusion. Grounded Pokemon can become affected by Yawn but cannot fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into a Fairy type, Nature Power becomes Moonblast, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower Special Attack by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Misty Terrain.
mistyterrain.shortDesc: 5 turns. Can't status,-Dragon power vs grounded.

moonblast.shortDesc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
moonlight.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

morningsun.name: Morning Sun
morningsun.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
morningsun.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user has already been prevented from switching by this effect.
noretreat.shortDesc: Raises all stats by 1 (not acc/eva). Traps user.

outrage.name: Outrage

This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. outrage.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

paraboliccharge.name: Parabolic Charge
paraboliccharge.desc: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
paraboliccharge.shortDesc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

partingshot.name: Parting Shot
partingshot.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If this move is successful, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if the target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages were both unchanged, or if there are no unfainted party members.
partingshot.shortDesc: Lowers target's Atk, Sp. Atk by 1. User switches.

payback.name: Payback
payback.desc: Power doubles if the user moves after the target this turn, including actions taken through Instruct or the Dancer Ability. Switching in does not count as an action.
payback.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user moves after the target.

perishsong.name: Perish Song
perishsong.desc: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.
perishsong.shortDesc: All active Pokemon will faint in 3 turns.

petalblizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
petalblizzard.shortDesc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

petaldance.name: Petal Dance
petaldance.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. petaldance.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

phantomforce.name: Phantom Force
phantomforce.desc: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
phantomforce.shortDesc: Disappears turn 1. Hits turn 2. Breaks protection.

pinmissile.name: Pin Missile

If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

powersplit.shortDesc: Averages Attack and Sp. Atk stats with target.

powerswap.name: Power Swap
powerswap.desc: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.
powerswap.shortDesc: Swaps Attack and Sp. Atk stat stages with target.

powertrick.name: Power Trick
powertrick.desc: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.
powertrick.shortDesc: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.

powertrip.name: Power Trip
powertrip.desc: Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.
powertrip.shortDesc: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.

protect.name: Protect
protect.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
protect.shortDesc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.

psychic.name: Psychic

psychicfangs.name: Psychic Fangs

psychicfangs.shortDesc: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.

psychicnoise.name: Psychic Noise

During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.
psychicnoise.shortDesc: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from healing.

psychicterrain.name: Psychic Terrain
