psychup.name: Psych Up
psychup.desc: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.
psychup.shortDesc: Copies the target's current stat stages.

psyshieldbash.name: Psyshield Bash
psyshieldbash.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
psyshieldbash.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.desc: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
psyshock.shortDesc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.

quash.name: Quash
quash.desc: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
quash.shortDesc: Forces the target to move last this turn.

quickguard.name: Quick Guard
quickguard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
quickguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from priority attacks this turn.

quiverdance.name: Quiver Dance
quiverdance.desc: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
quiverdance.shortDesc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.

ragefist.name: Rage Fist
ragefist.desc: Power is equal to 50+(X*50), where X is the total number of times the user has been hit by a damaging attack during the battle, even if the user did not lose HP from the attack. X cannot be greater than 6 and resets to 0 when the user leaves the field. Each hit of a multi-hit attack is counted, but confusion damage is not counted.
ragefist.shortDesc: +50 BP/hit on user. Max 6 hits. Resets on switch-out.

ragepowder.name: Rage Powder
ragepowder.desc: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
ragepowder.shortDesc: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.

ragingbull.name: Raging Bull
ragingbull.desc: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated. If the user's current form is a Paldean Tauros, this move's type changes to match. Fighting type for Combat Breed, Fire type for Blaze Breed, and Water type for Aqua Breed.
ragingbull.shortDesc: Destroys screens. Type depends on user's form.

ragingfury.name: Raging Fury
ragingfury.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
ragingfury.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

raindance.name: Rain Dance
raindance.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain Dance. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain Dance.
raindance.shortDesc: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.

rapidspin.name: Rapid Spin
rapidspin.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
rapidspin.shortDesc: Free user from hazards/bind/Leech Seed; +1 Spe.

razorshell.name: Razor Shell
razorshell.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
razorshell.shortDesc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.

recover.name: Recover
recover.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
recover.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.desc: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.
recycle.shortDesc: Restores the item the user last used.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
reflect.shortDesc: For 5 turns, physical damage to allies is halved.

reflecttype.name: Reflect Type
reflecttype.desc: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.
reflecttype.shortDesc: User becomes the same type as the target.

rest.name: Rest
rest.desc: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.
rest.shortDesc: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.desc: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP * 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
reversal.shortDesc: More power the less HP the user has left.

risingvoltage.name: Rising Voltage
risingvoltage.desc: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain and the target is grounded, this move's power is doubled.
risingvoltage.shortDesc: 2x power if target is grounded in Electric Terrain.

roar.name: Roar
roar.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
roar.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

rockblast.name: Rock Blast
rockblast.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

rockpolish.name: Rock Polish
rockpolish.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

rockslide.name: Rock Slide
rockslide.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
rockslide.shortDesc: 30% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.

rocktomb.name: Rock Tomb
rocktomb.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
rocktomb.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.

rockwrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
rockwrecker.desc: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

roleplay.name: Role Play
roleplay.desc: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
roleplay.shortDesc: User replaces its Ability with the target's.

roost.name: Roost
roost.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user is not Terastallized, until the end of the turn Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.
roost.shortDesc: Heals 50% HP. Flying-type removed 'til turn ends.

round.name: Round
round.desc: If there are other active Pokemon that chose this move for use this turn, those Pokemon take their turn immediately after the user, in Speed order, and this move's power is 120 for each other user.
round.shortDesc: Power doubles if others used Round this turn.

sacredsword.name: Sacred Sword
sacredsword.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.
sacredsword.shortDesc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.desc: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot have non-volatile status conditions or confusion inflicted on them by other Pokemon. Pokemon on the user's side cannot become affected by Yawn but can fall asleep from its effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Defog. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
safeguard.shortDesc: For 5 turns, protects user's party from status.

saltcure.name: Salt Cure
saltcure.desc: Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP (1/8 if the target is Steel or Water type), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
saltcure.shortDesc: Deals 1/16 max HP each turn; 1/8 on Steel, Water.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sandstorm. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are a Ground, Rock, or Steel type, or have the Magic Guard, Overcoat, Sand Force, Sand Rush, or Sand Veil Abilities. During the effect, the Special Defense of Rock-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a special attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Smooth Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sandstorm.
sandstorm.shortDesc: For 5 turns, a sandstorm rages. Rock: 1.5x SpD.

sandtomb.name: Sand Tomb
sandtomb.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
sandtomb.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

scald.name: Scald
scald.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
scald.shortDesc: 30% chance to burn the target. Thaws target.

scaleshot.name: Scale Shot
scaleshot.desc: Hits two to five times. Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage and raises the user's Speed by 1 stage after the last hit. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
scaleshot.shortDesc: Hits 2-5 times. User: -1 Def, +1 Spe after last hit.

scaryface.name: Scary Face
scaryface.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

scorchingsands.name: Scorching Sands
scorchingsands.desc: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
scorchingsands.shortDesc: 30% chance to burn the target. Thaws target.

screech.name: Screech
screech.desc: Lowers the target's Defense by 2 stages.

seismictoss.name: Seismic Toss
seismictoss.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.
seismictoss.shortDesc: Does damage equal to the user's level.

selfdestruct.name: Self-Destruct
selfdestruct.desc: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
selfdestruct.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.

shadowball.name: Shadow Ball
shadowball.desc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
shadowball.shortDesc: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

shadowclaw.name: Shadow Claw
shadowclaw.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

shadowpunch.name: Shadow Punch
shadowpunch.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

shedtail.name: Shed Tail
shedtail.desc: The user takes 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, and creates a substitute that has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP, rounded down. The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party and the selected Pokemon has the substitute transferred to it. Fails if the user would faint, or if there are no unfainted party members.
shedtail.shortDesc: User takes 1/2 its max HP to pass a substitute.

sheercold.name: Sheer Cold
sheercold.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + X)%, where X is 30 if the user is an Ice type and 20 otherwise, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Ice-type Pokemon and Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
sheercold.shortDesc: OHKOs non-Ice targets. Fails if user's lower level.

shellsidearm.name: Shell Side Arm
shellsidearm.desc: Has a 20% chance to poison the target. This move becomes a physical attack that makes contact if the value of ((((2 * the user's level / 5 + 2) * 90 * X) / Y) / 50), where X is the user's Attack stat and Y is the target's Defense stat, is greater than the same value where X is the user's Special Attack stat and Y is the target's Special Defense stat. No stat modifiers other than stat stage changes are considered for this purpose. If the two values are equal, this move chooses a damage category at random.
shellsidearm.shortDesc: 20% psn. Physical+contact if it would be stronger.

shellsmash.name: Shell Smash
shellsmash.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages.
shellsmash.shortDesc: Lowers Def, SpD by 1; raises Atk, SpA, Spe by 2.

shelter.name: Shelter
shelter.desc: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

simplebeam.name: Simple Beam
simplebeam.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

sing.name: Sing
sing.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

skillswap.name: Skill Swap
skillswap.desc: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
skillswap.shortDesc: The user and the target trade Abilities.

skittersmack.name: Skitter Smack
skittersmack.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
skittersmack.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower target's Sp. Atk by 1.

skyattack.name: Sky Attack
skyattack.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
skyattack.shortDesc: Charges, then hits turn 2. 30% flinch. High crit.

slackoff.name: Slack Off
slackoff.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
slackoff.shortDesc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.

sleeppowder.name: Sleep Powder
sleeppowder.shortDesc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

sleeptalk.name: Sleep Talk
sleeptalk.desc: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Uproar, Wicked Torque, or any two-turn move.
sleeptalk.shortDesc: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.

sludgebomb.name: Sludge Bomb
sludgebomb.desc: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

sludgewave.name: Sludge Wave
sludgewave.desc: Has a 10% chance to poison the target.

smackdown.name: Smack Down
smackdown.desc: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

smartstrike.name: Smart Strike
smartstrike.shortDesc: This move does not check accuracy.

snaptrap.name: Snap Trap
snaptrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
snaptrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
snarl.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 1.

snore.name: Snore
snore.desc: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.
snore.shortDesc: User must be asleep. 30% chance to flinch target.

snowscape.name: Snowscape
snowscape.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. During the effect, the Defense of Ice-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a physical attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Snow.
snowscape.shortDesc: For 5 turns, snow falls. Ice: 1.5x Def.

soak.name: Soak
soak.desc: Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.
soak.shortDesc: Changes the target's type to Water.

solarbeam.name: Solar Beam
solarbeam.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.
solarbeam.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.

solarblade.name: Solar Blade
solarblade.desc: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Hail, Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, the move still requires a turn to charge.
solarblade.shortDesc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.

sparklingaria.name: Sparkling Aria
sparklingaria.desc: If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of its burn.
sparklingaria.shortDesc: The target is cured of its burn.

speedswap.name: Speed Swap
speedswap.desc: The user swaps its Speed stat with the target. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

spicyextract.name: Spicy Extract
spicyextract.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and lowers its Defense by 2 stages.
spicyextract.shortDesc: Raises target's Atk by 2 and lowers its Def by 2.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
spikes.shortDesc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.

spikyshield.name: Spiky Shield
spikyshield.desc: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
spikyshield.shortDesc: Protects from moves. Contact: loses 1/8 max HP.

spiritbreak.name: Spirit Break
spiritbreak.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
spiritbreak.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.

spiritshackle.name: Spirit Shackle
spiritshackle.desc: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
spiritshackle.shortDesc: Prevents the target from switching out.

spite.name: Spite
spite.desc: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.
spite.shortDesc: Lowers the PP of the target's last move by 4.

spitup.name: Spit Up
spitup.desc: Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Whether or not this move is successful, the user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
spitup.shortDesc: More power with more uses of Stockpile.

stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthrock.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
stealthrock.shortDesc: Hurts foes on switch-in. Factors Rock weakness.

steelbeam.name: Steel Beam
steelbeam.desc: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability.

steelroller.name: Steel Roller
steelroller.desc: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.
steelroller.shortDesc: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the terrain.

steelwing.name: Steel Wing
steelwing.desc: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
steelwing.shortDesc: 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.

stickyweb.name: Sticky Web
stickyweb.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, lowering the Speed by 1 stage of each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
stickyweb.shortDesc: Lowers Speed of grounded foes by 1 on switch-in.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.
stockpile.shortDesc: Raises user's Defense, Sp. Def by 1. Max 3 uses.

stompingtantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
stompingtantrum.desc: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
stompingtantrum.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.

stoneaxe.name: Stone Axe
stoneaxe.desc: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25x, 0.5x, neutral, 2x, or 4x, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
stoneaxe.shortDesc: Sets Stealth Rock on the target's side.

stoneedge.name: Stone Edge
stoneedge.desc: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

storedpower.name: Stored Power
storedpower.desc: Power is equal to 20+(X*20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.
storedpower.shortDesc: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.

stormthrow.name: Storm Throw
stormthrow.desc: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
stormthrow.shortDesc: Always results in a critical hit.

strengthsap.name: Strength Sap
strengthsap.desc: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.
strengthsap.shortDesc: User heals HP=target's Atk stat. Lowers Atk by 1.

stringshot.name: String Shot
stringshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

strugglebug.name: Struggle Bug
strugglebug.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.
strugglebug.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 1.

stuffcheeks.name: Stuff Cheeks
stuffcheeks.desc: Fails if the user is not holding a Berry. The user eats its Berry and raises its Defense by 2 stages. This effect is not prevented by the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room.
stuffcheeks.shortDesc: Fails unless the user has a berry. User eats Berry, Def +2.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.desc: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, if the user switches out or faints, or if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.
substitute.shortDesc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.

suckerpunch.name: Sucker Punch
suckerpunch.desc: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.
suckerpunch.shortDesc: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.

sunnyday.name: Sunny Day
sunnyday.desc: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sunny Day. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sunny Day.
sunnyday.shortDesc: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.

supercellslam.name: Supercell Slam
supercellslam.desc: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
supercellslam.shortDesc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.

superfang.name: Super Fang
superfang.desc: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
superfang.shortDesc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.desc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
superpower.shortDesc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.

surf.name: Surf
surf.desc: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.
surf.shortDesc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dive.

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.
swagger.shortDesc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 and confuses it.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.desc: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
swallow.shortDesc: Heals the user based on uses of Stockpile.

sweetkiss.name: Sweet Kiss
sweetkiss.shortDesc: Causes the target to become confused.

sweetscent.name: Sweet Scent
sweetscent.desc: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
switcheroo.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.

swordsdance.name: Swords Dance
swordsdance.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.desc: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Delta Stream or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
synthesis.shortDesc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.

syrupbomb.name: Syrup Bomb
syrupbomb.desc: If this move is successful, it causes the target's Speed to be lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn for 3 turns.
syrupbomb.shortDesc: Target's Speed is lowered by 1 stage for 3 turns.

tailslap.name: Tail Slap
tailslap.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.desc: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
tailwind.shortDesc: For 4 turns, allies' Speed is doubled.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
taunt.shortDesc: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.

tearfullook.name: Tearful Look
tearfullook.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
tearfullook.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.

teatime.name: Teatime
teatime.desc: All active Pokemon consume their held Berries. This effect is not prevented by substitutes, the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a Berry.
teatime.shortDesc: All active Pokemon consume held Berries.

teeterdance.name: Teeter Dance
teeterdance.desc: Causes the target to become confused.

temperflare.name: Temper Flare
temperflare.desc: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
temperflare.shortDesc: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.

terrainpulse.name: Terrain Pulse
terrainpulse.desc: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.
terrainpulse.shortDesc: User on terrain: power doubles, type varies.

thief.name: Thief
thief.desc: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
thief.shortDesc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.desc: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
thrash.shortDesc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.

throatchop.name: Throat Chop
throatchop.desc: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.
throatchop.shortDesc: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound moves.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.desc: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Desolate Land or Sunny Day, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
thunder.shortDesc: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thunderfang.name: Thunder Fang
thunderfang.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
thunderfang.shortDesc: 10% chance to paralyze. 10% chance to flinch.

thunderpunch.name: Thunder Punch
thunderpunch.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

thunderwave.name: Thunder Wave
thunderwave.desc: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
tickle.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1.

tidyup.name: Tidy Up
tidyup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.
tidyup.shortDesc: User +1 Atk, Spe. Clears all substitutes/hazards.

topsyturvy.name: Topsy-Turvy
topsyturvy.desc: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

torchsong.name: Torch Song
torchsong.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
torchsong.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.

torment.name: Torment
torment.desc: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
torment.shortDesc: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
toxic.shortDesc: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.

toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicspikes.desc: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.
toxicspikes.shortDesc: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.

toxicthread.name: Toxic Thread
toxicthread.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages and poisons it.
toxicthread.shortDesc: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 and poisons it.

trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.desc: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
trailblaze.shortDesc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.

transform.name: Transform
transform.desc: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.
transform.shortDesc: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.

triattack.name: Tri Attack
triattack.desc: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
triattack.shortDesc: 20% chance to paralyze or burn or freeze target.

trick.name: Trick
trick.desc: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
trick.shortDesc: User switches its held item with the target's.

trickortreat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trickortreat.desc: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
trickortreat.shortDesc: Adds Ghost to the target's type(s).

trickroom.name: Trick Room
trickroom.desc: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
trickroom.shortDesc: Goes last. For 5 turns, turn order is reversed.

triplearrows.name: Triple Arrows
triplearrows.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit.

tripleaxel.name: Triple Axel
tripleaxel.desc: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
tripleaxel.shortDesc: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.

tropkick.name: Trop Kick
tropkick.desc: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
tropkick.shortDesc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.

twinbeam.name: Twin Beam
twinbeam.desc: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

upperhand.name: Upper Hand
upperhand.desc: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn with altered priority greater than 0, or if the target moves before the user.
upperhand.shortDesc: 100% flinch. Fails unless target using priority attack.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.desc: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
uproar.shortDesc: Lasts 3 turns. Active Pokemon cannot fall asleep.

uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
uturn.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.desc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.
venoshock.shortDesc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
voltswitch.desc: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
voltswitch.shortDesc: User switches out after damaging the target.

volttackle.name: Volt Tackle
volttackle.desc: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
volttackle.shortDesc: Has 33% recoil. 10% chance to paralyze target.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
waterpulse.desc: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

watershuriken.name: Water Shuriken
watershuriken.desc: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is an Ash-Greninja with the Battle Bond Ability, this move has a power of 20 and always hits three times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
watershuriken.shortDesc: Usually goes first. Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

waterspout.name: Water Spout
waterspout.desc: Power is equal to (user's current HP * 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
waterspout.shortDesc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).

wavecrash.name: Wave Crash
wavecrash.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

weatherball.name: Weather Ball
weatherball.desc: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Delta Stream is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Desolate Land or Sunny Day. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Primordial Sea, Rain Dance, Desolate Land, or Sunny Day, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.
weatherball.shortDesc: Power doubles and type varies in each weather.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
whirlpool.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
whirlwind.shortDesc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.

wideguard.name: Wide Guard
wideguard.desc: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
wideguard.shortDesc: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.

wildcharge.name: Wild Charge
wildcharge.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.
wish.shortDesc: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
wonderroom.shortDesc: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.desc: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

worryseed.name: Worry Seed
worryseed.desc: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.desc: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
wrap.shortDesc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.
yawn.shortDesc: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.

zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapcannon.desc: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zenheadbutt.desc: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
zenheadbutt.shortDesc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
